title: Work panel: test Urgent strip toggle-close (no reveal) and no reveal replay after a view switch
outcome: Tests pin the Urgent strip reveal rules: a second strip click on the selected item closes its details and sends no reveal (a branch collapsed afterwards stays collapsed), and a reveal request made before a view switch is not replayed when Dependencies/Hierarchy/Labels remount.
acceptance: Work panel: test Urgent strip toggle-close (no reveal) and no reveal replay after a view switch is done
